hebrewText: וְ/יַפְקֵ֨ד הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ פְּקִידִים֮ בְּ/כָל מְדִינ֣וֹת מַלְכוּת/וֹ֒ וְ/יִקְבְּצ֣וּ אֶת כָּל נַעֲרָֽה בְ֠תוּלָה טוֹבַ֨ת מַרְאֶ֜ה אֶל שׁוּשַׁ֤ן הַ/בִּירָה֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים אֶל יַ֥ד הֵגֶ֛א סְרִ֥יס הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַ/נָּשִׁ֑ים וְ/נָת֖וֹן תַּמְרוּקֵי/הֶֽן

tokens.bdb: to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.
tokens.kjv: appoint, [idiom] at all, avenge, bestow, (appoint to have the, give a) charge, commit, count, deliver to keep, be empty, enjoin, go see, hurt, do judgment, lack, lay up, look, make, [idiom] by any means, miss, number, officer, (make) overseer, have (the) oversight, punish, reckon, (call to) remember(-brance), set (over), sum, [idiom] surely, visit, want.

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.
tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: a superintendent (civil, military or religious)
tokens.kjv: which had the charge, governor, office, overseer, (that) was set.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region
tokens.kjv: ([idiom] every) province.

tokens.bdb: a rule; concretely, a dominion
tokens.kjv: empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.

tokens.bdb: to grasp, i.e. collect
tokens.kjv: assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, [idiom] surely, take up.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a girl (from infancy to adolescence)
tokens.kjv: damsel, maid(-en), young (woman).

tokens.bdb: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
tokens.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).
tokens.enLiteralWord: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.explanation: tov — bom, correto, agradável, útil, virtuoso
tokens.explanationEn: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun

tokens.bdb: a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision
tokens.kjv: [idiom] apparently, appearance(-reth), [idiom] as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

tokens.kjv: Hegai, Hege.
